name: Harps
overview: Scripture reveals that harps serve as instruments of worship and praise to God, used both in joyful dedication as seen in Nehemiah 12:27 and in personal expressions of gladness in Psalms 43:4. They accompany both human and heavenly worship, with Daniel 3:7 showing their use in various musical ensembles, and Revelation 5:8 and 14:2 depicting harps in the worship of the Lamb and heavenly praise. While Ephesians 5:19 emphasizes singing and making melody in the heart, the presence of harps underscores the importance of music as a means to glorify God and express the prayers of the saints.
